# @cursor/sdk-win32-x64

Platform-specific binaries for [`@cursor/sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cursor/sdk). This package provides `rg.exe`, `cursorsandbox.exe`, and the vendored tree-sitter shell-parsing runtime.

You should not install this package directly. It is installed automatically as an optional dependency of `@cursor/sdk` when running on win32-x64.
